integrity: The delivered finite proof includes executable independent face/matching/acyclicity and mod-two boundary checks, with exact byte hashes in the enclosing package. The homotopy proof is an exhaustive discrete-Morse certificate, not an unverified numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for the four-robust clique complex of the 4 by 4 Cartesian grid. No uniform formula or general higher-robustness conjecture is proved; equivalent unindexed work is possible.
title: The \(4\)-robust clique complex of the \(4\times4\) grid is \(\bigvee^{84}S^5\)
